sentences.text: There was once a very proud light who believed that he was better than all other lights.
He was made for a royal wedding, which made him feel extremely important.
When people spoke to him, he answered with great pride because he thought his mind was very high.
Other lights tried to be nice, but the light only looked down upon them.
He even began to cry when he thought about how wonderful he truly was.
His tears were real, but he believed they showed how deeply he cared about his own brilliant nature.
The king son was getting married, and a grand show of lights was planned for the evening.
The light knew that his part in the celebration would be the most amazing event of the night.
When the big moment finally arrived, many bright lights shot up into the dark sky.
They made wonderful colors that everyone watched with happy eyes.
However, when workers tried to light the proud light, he refused to burn properly.
Because his liquid had become wet from his own silly tears, nothing happened at all.
The workers felt very angry and threw him away into a dark hole near a small stream.
The light remained there in the soft ground, feeling quite sad though he still tried to act important.
Two local boys found him the next morning while they were walking along the water.
They thought the old metal tube might be useful for a small game, so they put him into their pocket.
Later, the boys placed him on the ground and lit a fire beneath him to see what would happen.
The light was very excited because he thought this was his second chance to shine.
He rose up into the air, but he flew so fast that nobody even saw him go.
He fell back down into a field, made a tiny sound, and completely went away.
Many people remember the story of the proud light who failed during the royal wedding.
If his liquid had not become wet, he would have shone brightly across the sky.
Instead, he spent his time in the ground before the boys found him by the water.
Everything that happened to him taught a lesson about pride and how people should behave.
He always wanted to be the center of attention, but he only ended up in a small field.
Perhaps if he had been nice to others, his life would have taken a different path.
We can learn from his mistakes and try to remain small no matter how important we feel.
Life is full of moments where our choices define who we truly are in the end.
The royal wedding was an event that many generations would discuss for a long time.
Guests came from all over the country to see the wonderful celebration and the bright shows.
Every worker worked hard to ensure that everything went according to the strict plan.
When the light failed, the crowd was quite surprised by the strange silence.
Workers usually check every detail before they start any important show.
However, nobody could predict that the light would cry and ruin his own chance to shine.
The little boys who found him later had no idea about his royal background.
They just saw a metal object that might be fun to play with during their morning walk.
After the boys placed him on the ground, the final moment of the light finally came.
He shot up into the air so fast that people could barely follow his movement.
His journey ended quickly when he fell back down into the open grass.
Nobody heard him make any significant sound as he went away from sight.
The story remains a classic example of how pride often leads to a strange fall.
Even today, children and adults both can enjoy the tale of the light and his tears.
We should always remember to treat everyone with respect and care every single day.
That way, we can avoid the same result as the proud light who thought he was better than everyone else.

sentences.text: There was once a remarkably haughty pyrotechnic device who harbored the absolute conviction that he was vastly superior to all other illuminations in the realm.
Fashioned expressly for a royal wedding, he felt an intoxicating sense of importance pulsing through his metallic core.
Whenever lesser candles or lanterns spoke to him, he would reply with an air of profound condescension, utterly convinced of his superior intellect.
Other lights occasionally attempted to cultivate a pleasant conversation, but the arrogant cylinder consistently looked down upon their humble flickers.
So moved was he by his own imagined magnificence that he would frequently weep gentle tears of pure admiration for his own brilliant nature.
Though his moisture was entirely genuine, he convinced himself that these emotional drops were proof of his deep sensitivity and noble spirit.
The young prince of the kingdom was preparing to take his bride, and a magnificent display of illumination was meticulously planned for the evening festivities.
The proud rocket knew without a single doubt that his grand finale would eclipse every other event of the evening.
He envisioned himself soaring into the velvety darkness, leaving the entire court gasping at his unprecedented radiance.
Every worker labored tirelessly behind the scenes to ensure that every detail of the strict schedule proceeded without a flaw.
When the crucial moment finally arrived, a chorus of brilliant lights shot up into the dark sky with breathtaking velocity.
They burst into wondrous cascades of color that every spectator watched with wide, happy eyes.
However, when the technicians finally attempted to ignite the proud rocket, he stubbornly refused to cooperate or burn properly.
Because his internal composition had become dampened by his own excessive and foolish tears, nothing happened at all.
The spark hissed briefly against the damp paper and vanished, leaving the cylinder completely inert.
Overcome by sudden fury at the ruined schedule, the workers felt deeply angry and hurled the heavy tube away.
It fell unceremoniously into a dark, muddy hole near a small, babbling stream.
The light remained half-buried in the soft ground, feeling quite miserable yet still attempting to maintain his grand posture.
The following morning, two local boys happened to walk along the winding water while searching for adventure.
Their sharp eyes soon discovered the discarded metal tube resting quietly in the damp earth.
Believing that the cylindrical object might prove useful for a small game they were inventing, they reached down and retrieved it.
Without any inkling of its royal background, they slipped the heavy metal casing directly into their pocket.
They continued their morning walk, quite satisfied with their curious little treasure and eager to test its capabilities.
The rocket, trapped inside the dark fabric of the pocket, listened to their muffled voices with a renewed surge of vanity.
Later in the day, the boys placed the damp tube upright on the open ground and carefully built a small fire beneath it.
They wanted to see what kind of reaction the mysterious object might produce.
The rocket felt a sudden jolt of intense excitement, fully convinced that this was his long-awaited second chance to shine.
He puffed his chest out metaphorically, preparing for an ascent that would surely astonish the entire countryside.
With a sudden hiss of pent-up energy, he shot straight up into the air with astonishing speed.
His departure was so rapid that nobody standing nearby even managed to catch a glimpse of his trajectory.
He climbed far higher than anyone could have anticipated, piercing the upper air before gravity finally recalled him.
He tumbled headfirst back down toward the earth, landing heavily in a quiet, empty field.
Upon impact, he made a tiny, pathetic sound and completely sputtered out of existence.
No grand applause greeted his arrival, and not a single spectator watched his descent from the heavens.
The magnificent promise of his royal debut had ended in absolute obscurity among the quiet grass.
His brief, blinding career was finished forever in a matter of mere seconds.
Many people across the kingdom continued to remember the strange story of the proud light who failed during the royal celebration.
If only his internal components had not been spoiled by moisture, he would have truly shone brilliantly across the evening sky.
Instead, he spent his humiliating hours hiding in the damp ground before the children found him by the water.
Everything that happened to him offered a clear lesson about the dangers of excessive vanity and improper behavior.
He had desperately wanted to remain the absolute center of attention at every possible moment.
Yet his stubborn obsession with his own importance only delivered him to an anonymous field.
Had he chosen to treat others with kindness and humility, his life story might have taken a vastly different path.
We can all learn valuable lessons from his ridiculous mistakes and try to remain modest no matter how important we feel.
Human existence is constantly filled with defining moments where our choices reveal who we truly are beneath the surface.
The royal wedding itself remained a legendary event that generations of townspeople would discuss for many decades.
Guests had traveled from distant provinces just to witness the grand celebration and the dazzling shows.
Every laborer had worked tirelessly to guarantee that the elaborate schedule unfolded according to plan.
When the proud light malfunctioned, the surrounding crowd had been genuinely surprised by the sudden, awkward silence.
Experienced technicians usually inspect every single component with extreme care before launching any ambitious exhibition.
However, no professional could possibly have predicted that a pyrotechnic device would ruin its own performance through sheer vanity.
The little boys who discovered him by the stream had no concept of his grand origins or his failed destiny.
They simply recognized a discarded piece of metal that might provide amusement during their morning excursion.
When they finally set him upon the earth and applied the flame, the final chapter of his existence began.
He had shot upward with such tremendous velocity that onlookers could barely follow his motion through the air.
His grand journey concluded abruptly as he plummeted back into the open grass without an audience.
Scarcely anyone heard him make a significant sound as he vanished permanently from the visual field.
This unfortunate tale remains a classic example of how unchecked arrogance consistently paves the way for a peculiar fall.
To this day, both children and adults can reflect upon the cautionary tale of the weeping light.
We must continually remind ourselves to treat every person with genuine respect and thoughtful consideration.
By practicing humility in our daily interactions, we can easily avoid sharing the miserable fate of the boastful rocket.
He had truly believed that his superior intellect set him apart from every other creation in the workshop.
Yet his refusal to connect with those around him guaranteed his eventual downfall in the mud.
True worth is rarely found in loud boasts or manufactured tears of self-admiration.
Instead, it emerges quietly through kindness, patience, and a willingness to stand shoulder to shoulder with others.
Let us remember the lesson of the field and choose a path of grace over the empty pursuit of pride.
